name: ai
description: Personal Claude Code plugins — vault-librarian for curating Markdown knowledge vaults, work-register for the daily work register and its Kanban board.

plugins.name: vault-librarian
plugins.description: Curate any Markdown knowledge vault: catalogue, classify, audit, repair frontmatter, rename with link rewrite, check broken links, inject emoji sigils, infer tags, and detect themes. Works with Obsidian, mkdocs, Jekyll, or any .md tree with YAML frontmatter.

plugins.name: work-register
plugins.description: A daily work register and its derived Obsidian Kanban board(s), under per-field ownership: day files own a card's existence and text, the board owns its column. Captures a day's intent, syncs additively so a drag is never clobbered, reconciles board status back onto the day files, and answers lookups in a few hundred bytes instead of a whole-board read. Ships a SessionStart pulse that surfaces the session's own open cards.
